observation.command:
echo "=== Inspect Filament login form fields ==="
curl -s --max-time 15 http://localhost:3001/admin/login -o /tmp/fl_login.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n"
grep -oE '<form[^>]*>' /tmp/fl_login.html
echo "--- input fields ---"
grep -oE '<input[^>]*(name|type)="[^"]*"[^>]*>' /tmp/fl_login.html | grep -oE '(name|value|type)="[^"]*"' | head -20
echo "--- check for wire:snapshot / livewire ---"
grep -oE 'wire:snapshot' /tmp/fl_login.html | head -2
echo
echo "=== Full login page title & key markers ==="
grep -oiE '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/fl_login.html
